note: cost: opening price in political power, before tensionDiscount and any charge given in effect. options: one act, its kind chosen when taken, each kind with its own cost and needs. notByMembers: a realm's member may not take it; its realm does. bindsMembers: when a realm takes it or is its target, every member takes part with it. cooldownDays: days before a country may take it again against the same country. notAgainstOwnVassals: a country may not take it against its own colonies, puppets or other vassals. notByVassals: a colony, puppet or other vassal may not take it against anyone; its suzerain does. notAgainstOwnSuzerain: a vassal may take it, but not against its own suzerain. onlyByMembers: only a realm's member may take it, and only toward its own realm. needs: a relations figure is read as the target's view of the actor, so a country may act toward one it dislikes when the other is willing.

tensionDiscount.note: perPoint: political power off the act per point of world tension, floored at floor times the listed cost.

actions.name: Improve relations
actions.effect: +0.1 a day to the other's view of the actor while it runs, to a ceiling of +30 from this source, and a quarter of that to the actor's view of the other. Once it stops, what it built fades 10 a year. Costs 0.2 political power per day on the same compass point, rising to 0.4 per day at opposite corners

actions.name: Denounce
actions.effect: -20 to each side's view of the other at once, fading 5 a year, and the other side may not improve relations for 90 days. A second denunciation, by either side, adds another -20 to both views on top of what is left

actions.name: Guarantee
actions.effect: the guarantor enters any war declared on the guaranteed. Refusing costs 30 stability, recovering over a year at 2.5 a month, and every guarantee it holds

actions.name: Non-aggression pact
actions.effect: neither may justify war on the other or declare war on it for a term of years agreed at signing. +5 relations while it holds. Either may leave early on 90 days notice, at -25 relations; a guarantee or alliance that would take one to war against the other breaks it at the same cost

actions.name: Alliance

options.name: Economic
options.effect: suspended between belligerents rather than broken, and resumes at peace

options.name: Technological
options.effect: suspended between belligerents rather than broken, and resumes at peace

options.name: Military
options.needs: +50 relations with every member, and not barred
options.effect: the members enter one another's wars. Two members may not declare on each other

actions.effect: founds an alliance of the kind chosen, or joins one that already stands. A country may belong to as many as it can meet the terms for

actions.name: Military access
actions.effect: divisions may cross and draw supply through. Withdrawn at any time, at -25 relations

actions.name: Sanctions
actions.effect: the target's exportable surplus and importable shortfall fall 0.25 for as long as they hold, -30 to the target's view of the sanctioner. Costs 2% of political power income a day on top of the opening charge

actions.name: State agreement
actions.effect: a daily supply of one good for a term: a resource, equipment or ships, sent as the things themselves, from the supplier's stock or built for the order. At a price, in money or in goods, it is a trade, +0.05 a day to the receiver's view of the supplier to +10; at no price it is lend lease, +0.05 a day to +30. The supplier's view of the receiver takes a quarter of either. Cancelling early costs the canceller -15 relations

actions.name: Development aid
actions.effect: one level of road or electricity, or one railed county, built in the other country's province at the investor's expense. The level is the host's. 15 a level, weighted by relations

actions.name: Lease deposit
actions.effect: an agreed number of a deposit's units is worked by the lessee for a term of years, at a rent

actions.name: Request deposit lease
actions.effect: asks the other country to lease out an agreed number of a named deposit's units for a term of years, at a rent. Theirs to accept or refuse

actions.name: Send volunteers
actions.effect: up to 3 divisions fight under the target's command without a war. Losses are yours. -25 to the view of the sender held by every country the target is at war with, +10 to the target's view of the sender

actions.name: Expeditionary force
actions.effect: divisions pass under the other's command entirely, and count against their supply and not yours

actions.name: Justify war
actions.effect: a casus belli against one country, good for a year. 60 over 60 days, or 25 over 25 days on a claim

actions.name: Declare war
actions.effect: war. Free with a casus belli, 200 without one

actions.name: Ask for diplomatic action
actions.effect: a realm's member asks its realm to take a named diplomatic action against a named country. The realm takes it at its own cost, or refuses. Theirs to accept or refuse
